top_reply.text: Create Image Create a clean, minimalist, high-end facial beauty report based on this photo. Use a black-and-white design with fine lines, rounded-edge cards, and a luxury aesthetic. Include a simple drawing of the facial contour, an honest analysis of attractiveness (symmetry, proportions, bone structure, skin, etc.), clear scores, strengths, areas for improvement, and practical grooming/style recommendations. Maintain a data-driven approach, visually refined, and without being overly flattering.
